name: beamhop
description: Read captures saved locally by Beamhop from Claude Desktop and Cowork.
long_description: Beamhop exposes the user's local Capture Inbox as read-only MCP resources and a fetch_capture tool. Capture content remains on this Mac and is returned only when Claude invokes the tool.

tools.name: fetch_capture
tools.description: Fetch a local Beamhop capture by id, or fetch the latest capture when id is omitted. Read-only.
